Card Q&A.a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards. Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can process it. Even if this Digimon's stack doesn't have 2 or more same-level cards, this card's [When Digivolving] effect will return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This card isn't yet a digivolution card at the End of Your Turn timing, therefore this card's inherited effect doesn't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: At the end of my turn, can I use another effect to DNA digivolve using 2 cards including this Digimon, then activate this card's inherited effect once it becomes a digivolution card?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, trash any 4 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
Inherited Effect: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Night Claw]/[Light Fang]/[CS] trait: Cost 3
